description: Sealed geared guitar tuning machine (Grover Rotomatic 102 class) as a four-part assembly: die-cast housing with outboard screw ear, string post with transverse string hole, pear tuning button on the key shaft, and the separate peghole bushing (press-in collar or hex ferrule).
source: Grover Rotomatic 102 + Gotoh SG381 dimensioned drawings (post/bushing/housing/mount); proportion for housing depth and key shaft
